title: Free module presheaf Čech complex is exact in positive degrees
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,\mathcal O)$ be a ringed site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let $\mathcal U=\{U_i\to U\}_{i\in J}$ be a covering, and for each object $V$ let $\mathcal O_V$ be the free presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules represented by $V$, namely $\mathcal O_V(W)=\bigoplus_{f:W\to V}\mathcal O(W)$. Put $K_p=\bigoplus_{(i_0,\ldots,i_p)\in J^{p+1}}\mathcal O_{U_{i_0}\times_U\cdots\times_UU_{i_p}}$ with alternating differential induced by the projections deleting one factor. Then $K_\bullet$ is exact in every positive degree in the category of presheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules.
